children.translated_text: Now, therefore, the inquiry into <s>Brahman</s> (BS 1.1.1)
From which arises the origin and so on of this [universe] (BS 1.1.2)
Because scripture is its source of knowledge (BS 1.1.3)
But that [<s>Brahman</s> is known from scripture] because of the harmonious consistency [of the Upaniṣadic texts] (BS 1.1.4)
[<s>Pradhāna</s> is] not [the cause referred to in scripture], because [scripture] speaks of [the cause as] seeing (<s>īkṣaṇa</s>), which is not a quality of the non-conscious (BS 1.1.5)
If [it be said that the reference to <s>Brahman</s> is] secondary, [we say] no, because of the word '<s>Ātman</s>' [being used] (BS 1.1.6)
Because liberation is taught for one who is devoted to that [<s>Brahman</s>] (BS 1.1.7)
And because there is no statement that it is to be rejected (BS 1.1.8)
Because [the individual self] merges into its own self [in deep sleep, <s>Brahman</s> is the cause] (BS 1.1.9)
Because of the uniformity of the teaching [in all Upaniṣads about <s>Brahman</s> as the cause] (BS 1.1.10)
And because it is so stated in scripture (BS 1.1.11)
<s>Ānandamaya</s> (the one consisting of bliss) [is <s>Brahman</s>], because of repetition [of the word bliss in the Upaniṣad] (BS 1.1.12)

children.text: vikāraśabdān neti cen na prācuryāt | BBs_1,1.13 |
children.translated_text: If [it be objected that <s>ānandamaya</s> is] not [<s>Brahman</s>] because of the suffix denoting modification, [we say] no, because [the suffix is used] in the sense of abundance (BS 1.1.13)
And because [scripture] declares [<s>Brahman</s>] to be the cause of that [bliss] (BS 1.1.14)
Moreover, that which is described in the <s>mantra</s> verses is declared [in the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> portion too as <s>Brahman</s>] (BS 1.1.15)
The other [the individual soul] is not [meant], because of the impossibility [of the qualities applying to it] (BS 1.1.16)
And because of the declaration of difference [between the individual soul and <s>ānandamaya</s>] (BS 1.1.17)
And because of [the fulfilment of] desire, there is no dependence on inference [i.e. <s>Pradhāna</s> of <s>Sāṃkhya</s>] (BS 1.1.18)

children.text: asminn asya ca tadyogaṃ śāsti | BBs_1,1.19 |
children.translated_text: [Scripture] teaches that in this [<s>Brahman</s>] there is the union of this [individual soul] with that [<s>Brahman</s>] (BS 1.1.19)
[The being referred to as] within [the sun is <s>Brahman</s>], because its qualities are taught [in that passage] (BS 1.1.20)
And [the being within the sun is] different [from the individual soul], because of the declaration of difference (BS 1.1.21)
<s>Ākāśa</s> (space) [referred to in the Upaniṣad is <s>Brahman</s>], because of the indicatory marks of that [<s>Brahman</s>] (BS 1.1.22)
For the same reason, <s>Prāṇa</s> (breath/life-force) [is also <s>Brahman</s>] (BS 1.1.23)
<s>Jyotis</s> (light) [mentioned in the Upaniṣad is <s>Brahman</s>], because of the mention of feet (<s>caraṇa</s>) [as quarters of <s>Brahman</s>] (BS 1.1.24)

children.text: chando 'bhidhānān neti cen na tathā ceto'rpaṇanigadāt tathā hi darśanam | BBs_1,1.25 |
children.translated_text: If [it be said that <s>jyotis</s> is] not [<s>Brahman</s>] because of the reference to <s>chandas</s> (metre), [we say] no, because thus [the passage] teaches the directing of the mind [to <s>Brahman</s>]; for so the scripture shows (BS 1.1.25)
And thus [<s>Brahman</s> is meant] because it is reasonable to designate [<s>Brahman</s>] by terms such as 'elements' and 'feet' (BS 1.1.26)

children.text: upadeśabhedān neti cen nobhayasminn apy avirodhāt | BBs_1,1.27 |
children.translated_text: If [it be said that <s>Brahman</s> is] not [meant] because of the difference in instruction, [we say] no, because there is no contradiction in either [interpretation] (BS 1.1.27)
<s>Prāṇa</s> [mentioned in the Kauṣītaki Upaniṣad is <s>Brahman</s>], because of the conformity [of the attributes described with <s>Brahman</s>] (BS 1.1.28)

children.text: na vaktur ātmopadeśād iti ced adhyātmasaṃbandhabhūmā hy asmin | BBs_1,1.29 |
children.translated_text: If [it be said that <s>Prāṇa</s> is] not [<s>Brahman</s>] because it is taught as the self of the speaker, [we say no], for there is an abundance of references to the inner self in this [passage] (BS 1.1.29)
But the teaching [of identity with <s>Brahman</s>] is from the standpoint of scripture, like [the case of] <s>Vāmadeva</s> (BS 1.1.30)

children.text: jīvamukhyaprāṇaliṅgān neti cen nopāsātraividhyādāśritatvād iha tadyogāt | BBs_1,1.31 |
children.translated_text: If [it be said that <s>Prāṇa</s> is] not [<s>Brahman</s>] because of the marks of the individual soul, the chief vital air, and [the sense organs], [we say] no, because worship is threefold, and because [the passage] depends on [<s>Brahman</s>] being connected with it here (BS 1.1.31)
[<s>Brahman</s> is the subject] everywhere [in the Upaniṣads], because what is well known is taught (BS 1.2.1)
And because the qualities intended [to be conveyed] are appropriate [only to <s>Brahman</s>] (BS 1.2.2)
But [the being referred to is] not the embodied self (<s>jīva</s>), because of the impossibility [of the attributes applying to it] (BS 1.2.3)
And because of the declaration [of the being as both] the object and the agent of action (BS 1.2.4)
Because of the specific [scriptural] words [that point to <s>Brahman</s>] (BS 1.2.5)
And because of the <s>Smṛti</s> [supporting this interpretation] (BS 1.2.6)

children.text: arbhakaustvāt tadvyapadeśāc ca neti cen na nicāyyatvād evaṃ vyomavac ca | BBs_1,2.7 |
children.translated_text: If [it be said that <s>Brahman</s> is] not [meant] because of the smallness [of the abode], and because of the designation as such, [we say] no, because it is established to be so [despite the small abode], just as with <s>ākāśa</s> (space) (BS 1.2.7)

children.text: saṃbhogaprāptir iti cen na vaiśeṣyāt | BBs_1,2.8 |
children.translated_text: If [it be said that there would be the consequence of] experiencing [pleasure and pain by <s>Brahman</s>], [we say] no, because of the distinction [between <s>Brahman</s> and the individual soul] (BS 1.2.8)
The eater [mentioned in the Kaṭha Upaniṣad is <s>Brahman</s>], because [the passage] comprehends both the moving and the non-moving [i.e. the entire universe] (BS 1.2.9)
And because of the context [pointing to <s>Brahman</s>] (BS 1.2.10)

children.text: guhāṃ praviṣṭāv ātmānau hi taddarśanāt | BBs_1,2.11 |
children.translated_text: The two that have entered the cave [are] indeed the two selves [the supreme self and the individual self], for so the scripture shows (BS 1.2.11)
And because of the qualifying attributes [distinguishing the supreme self from the individual self] (BS 1.2.12)
The one within [the eye, mentioned in the Chāndogya Upaniṣad, is <s>Brahman</s>], because [the attributes] are appropriate [to <s>Brahman</s> alone] (BS 1.2.13)
And because of the designation of place and other [attributes of <s>Brahman</s>] (BS 1.2.14)
And because of the reference [to <s>Brahman</s>] by a designation distinguished by bliss (BS 1.2.15)
And because the path of attainment heard in the Upaniṣad [applies to <s>Brahman</s>] (BS 1.2.16)
The other [i.e. the individual soul or <s>Pradhāna</s>] is not [meant], because of the impossibility of abiding [in the eye] and of [the attributes] being possible [for them] (BS 1.2.17)

The <s>Antaryāmin</s> (inner controller) [described] in the passages on the divine, cosmic, and other [spheres is <s>Brahman</s>], because of the declaration of attributes belonging to that [<s>Brahman</s>] (BS 1.2.18)
And [the <s>Antaryāmin</s> is] not that which is known from <s>Smṛti</s> [i.e. <s>Pradhāna</s>], because attributes not belonging to it are stated (BS 1.2.19)

children.text: śarīraś cobhaye 'pi hi bhedenainam adhīyate | BBs_1,2.20 |
children.translated_text: And [<s>Antaryāmin</s> is] the embodied self [<s>Brahman</s> dwelling in the body], for both [the Mādhyandina and Kāṇva] recensions read of him as different [from nature and the individual soul] (BS 1.2.20)
The possessor of qualities such as invisibility and so on [is <s>Brahman</s>], because of the declaration of [<s>Brahman</s>'s] attributes (BS 1.2.21)
And neither of the other two [<s>Pradhāna</s> or the individual soul is meant], because of the mention of distinguishing attributes and difference (BS 1.2.22)
And because of the description of form [applicable only to <s>Brahman</s>] (BS 1.2.23)
<s>Vaiśvānara</s> [is <s>Brahman</s>], because of the specific words that are common [to <s>Brahman</s> descriptions] (BS 1.2.24)
[If <s>Vaiśvānara</s> is <s>Brahman</s>], that which is recorded in <s>Smṛti</s> would be [merely] an inference (BS 1.2.25)

children.text: śabdādibhyo 'ntaḥpratiṣṭhānāc ca neti cen na tathā dṛṣṭyupadeśād asambhavāt puruṣamapi cainam adhīyate | BBs_1,2.26 |
children.translated_text: If [it be said that <s>Vaiśvānara</s> is] not [<s>Brahman</s>] because of the word and so on and because of its being established within, [we say] no, because the meditation is thus taught, because of the impossibility [otherwise], and because some [recensions] read of him as <s>Puruṣa</s> (person) (BS 1.2.26)

children.text: ata eva na devatā bhūtaṃ ca | BBs_1,2.27 |
children.translated_text: For the same reason, [<s>Vaiśvānara</s> is] neither the deity [of fire] nor the element [of fire] (BS 1.2.27)
<s>Jaimini</s> [holds that] even the direct [identification of <s>Vaiśvānara</s> as the measured form is] not contradictory (BS 1.2.28)
[<s>Vaiśvānara</s> refers to <s>Brahman</s>] because of manifestation — thus [says] <s>Āśmarathya</s> (BS 1.2.29)
Because of remembrance [of identity at death], [thus says] <s>Bādari</s> (BS 1.2.30)

children.text: saṃpatter iti jaiminis tathā hi darśayati | BBs_1,2.31 |
children.translated_text: Because of attainment [of <s>Brahman</s>], thus [says] <s>Jaimini</s>; for so [the scripture] shows (BS 1.2.31)
And [the Upaniṣads] declare him [<s>Vaiśvānara</s> as <s>Brahman</s>] in this [context] (BS 1.2.32)
That whose abode is heaven, earth, and so on [is <s>Brahman</s>], because of the [use of <s>Brahman</s>'s] own word (BS 1.3.1)
And because [it is] declared as that which the liberated approach (BS 1.3.2)
[It is] not the inferred [<s>Pradhāna</s>], because of the absence of that term [in the Upaniṣad] (BS 1.3.3)
And because [it is described as] the sustainer of life (<s>prāṇabhṛt</s>) [which applies only to a conscious being] (BS 1.3.4)
Because of the declaration of difference [between it and the individual soul] (BS 1.3.5)
Because of the context [which points to <s>Brahman</s>] (BS 1.3.6)
And because of [the mention of] sustenance and eating [which are appropriate to <s>Brahman</s>] (BS 1.3.7)
<s>Bhūman</s> (the Infinite) [in the Chāndogya Upaniṣad is <s>Brahman</s>], taught as beyond <s>saṃprasāda</s> (the serene self) (BS 1.3.8)
And because the attributes [mentioned] are appropriate [to <s>Brahman</s>] (BS 1.3.9)
The <s>Akṣara</s> (Imperishable) [is <s>Brahman</s>], because of sustaining [everything] up to <s>ākāśa</s> (space) (BS 1.3.10)
And that [sustaining power belongs to <s>Brahman</s>], because of [its] commanding [nature] (BS 1.3.11)
And because of the exclusion of any other nature [than <s>Brahman</s>] (BS 1.3.12)
That [referred to in the Praśna Upaniṣad] is he [<s>Brahman</s>], because of the designation as the object of the act of seeing (<s>īkṣati</s>) (BS 1.3.13)
The small [space within the heart, <s>dahara</s>, in the Chāndogya Upaniṣad is <s>Brahman</s>], because of the subsequent [statements supporting this] (BS 1.3.14)

children.text: gatiśabdābhyāṃ tathā hi dṛṣṭaṃ liṅgaṃ ca | BBs_1,3.15 |
children.translated_text: Because of the [mention of] going and the [use of the] word [<s>Brahman</s>]; for so the scripture shows, and there is the indicatory mark (BS 1.3.15)
And because the greatness [described in the passage] is sustained, and because of [its] being perceived in this [small space] (BS 1.3.16)
And because of [<s>Brahman</s>] being well known [as the referent in such contexts] (BS 1.3.17)

children.text: itaraparāmarśāt sa iti cen nāsaṃbhavāt | BBs_1,3.18 |
children.translated_text: If [it be said that the <s>dahara</s> space refers to] the other [the individual soul], because of a reference [to it], [we say] no, because of the impossibility [of the attributes applying to the individual soul] (BS 1.3.18)

If [it be argued] from a subsequent [passage that the individual soul is meant], but [the reference is to the soul] whose true nature has become manifest [i.e. the liberated soul, which is non-different from <s>Brahman</s>] (BS 1.3.19)
And the reference [to the individual soul] is for another purpose (BS 1.3.20)

children.text: alpaśruter iti cet tad uktam | BBs_1,3.21 |
children.translated_text: If [it be said that <s>Brahman</s> is not meant] because of the smallness of the abode, [we say] that has [already] been explained (BS 1.3.21)
Because of imitation [of <s>Brahman</s> by the individual soul], and because of that [<s>Brahman</s> being the topic] (BS 1.3.22)
Moreover, [this is] also stated in <s>Smṛti</s> (BS 1.3.23)
[<s>Brahman</s> is] known from the scriptural word alone (BS 1.3.24)
But [the meditation on the small space in the heart requires] reference to the heart, because [Vedic study and meditation are] a human qualification (BS 1.3.25)
But <s>Bādarāyaṇa</s> [holds that] even those above [i.e. the gods also have the right to knowledge], because it is possible (BS 1.3.26)

children.text: virodhaḥ karmaṇīti cen nānekapratipatter darśanāt | BBs_1,3.27 |
children.translated_text: If [it be said that there is] a contradiction regarding [the gods'] performance of rites, [we say] no, because multiple [forms of embodiment] are perceived in scripture (BS 1.3.27)

children.text: śabda iti cen nātaḥ prabhavāt pratyakṣānumānābhyām | BBs_1,3.28 |
children.translated_text: If [it be said that the Veda is] merely words [and hence not eternal, we say] no, because [the Veda] is the source of these [words], as [established] through perception and inference (BS 1.3.28)
And for this very reason [the Veda's] eternality [is established] (BS 1.3.29)
And because of the sameness of names and forms [in each creation cycle], there is no contradiction even in [the case of] repetition [of creation], as seen in scripture and <s>Smṛti</s> (BS 1.3.30)

<s>Jaimini</s> [holds that there is] no eligibility [for the gods] in [rites involving offerings to] <s>Madhu</s> and others, because of the impossibility [of the gods offering to themselves] (BS 1.3.31)
And because [the gods] exist in the [ritual] fire (BS 1.3.32)
But <s>Bādarāyaṇa</s> [holds that the gods] do have [eligibility for knowledge], for it does exist (BS 1.3.33)

children.text: śugasya tadanādaraśravaṇāt tadādravaṇāt sūcyate hi | BBs_1,3.34 |
children.translated_text: [The eligibility of the god of] grief [<s>Śūdras</s>] is indicated by the disregard heard [in scripture] and by the running toward [<s>Brahman</s> knowledge]; for it is suggested (BS 1.3.34)
And because the attainment of the <s>Kṣatriya</s> status [is mentioned] further on, by the indicatory mark of [the story of] <s>Caitraratha</s> (BS 1.3.35)
Because of the reference to <s>saṃskāras</s> (purificatory rites), and because of the statement of [their] absence (BS 1.3.36)
And because of the [Smṛti] proceeding [to prohibit Vedic study only] when the absence of that [saṃskāra is] ascertained (BS 1.3.37)
Because of the prohibition of hearing, studying, and [performing rites for] their benefit, and because of <s>Smṛti</s> (BS 1.3.38)
[<s>Brahman</s> is referred to as that which causes] trembling [of the universe] (BS 1.3.39)
[<s>Brahman</s> is meant] because of the vision of light (BS 1.3.40)
<s>Ākāśa</s> [mentioned in the Chāndogya Upaniṣad is <s>Brahman</s>], because of the designation as something different [from the ordinary elements], and so on (BS 1.3.41)
[<s>Brahman</s> is distinguished from the individual soul] by the difference [observed] in deep sleep and at the time of departure [from the body] (BS 1.3.42)
Because of the words 'Lord' and so on [being used, <s>Brahman</s> is meant] (BS 1.3.43)

children.text: ānumānikam apy ekeṣām iti cen na śarīra-rūpaka-vinyasta-gṛhīter darśayati ca | BBs_1,4.1 |
children.translated_text: If [it be said that] the inferred [<s>Pradhāna</s>] is [referred to] by some [Upaniṣadic passages], [we say] no, because the [passage] grasps [the term <s>avyakta</s>] in the metaphor of the body, and [the scripture] shows this (BS 1.4.1)
But the subtle [entity mentioned is the subtle body], because it deserves that [designation] (BS 1.4.2)
Because it [the subtle body] is dependent on that [<s>Brahman</s>], [the passage is] meaningful (BS 1.4.3)
And because there is no statement that it [<s>Pradhāna</s>] is to be known [as the cause] (BS 1.4.4)

children.text: vadatīti cen na prājño hi prakaraṇāt | BBs_1,4.5 |
children.translated_text: If [it be said that the Upaniṣad] speaks [of <s>Pradhāna</s>], [we say] no, for [the passage refers to] the intelligent [<s>Brahman</s>], because of the context (BS 1.4.5)

children.text: trayāṇām eva caivam upanyāsaḥ praśnaś ca | BBs_1,4.6 |
children.translated_text: And thus [the Upaniṣad] presents and questions only three [entities: the individual soul, the sense organs, and the elements — not <s>Pradhāna</s>] (BS 1.4.6)
And [this is to be understood] as in the case of the <s>mahat</s> [which is also not <s>Sāṃkhya</s>'s <s>mahat</s>] (BS 1.4.7)
As in the case of the cups (<s>camasa</s>), because of non-difference [between the passages referring to <s>Brahman</s>] (BS 1.4.8)

children.text: jyotirupakramā tu tathā hy adhīyata eke | BBs_1,4.9 |
children.translated_text: But [the passage beginning with] light [as its commencement refers to <s>Brahman</s>], for thus some [recensions] read (BS 1.4.9)
And there is no contradiction [in identifying this with <s>Brahman</s>], because the teaching is figurative, as in the case of <s>Madhu</s> and others (BS 1.4.10)

children.text: na saṃkhyopasaṃgrahād api nānābhāvād atirekāc ca | BBs_1,4.11 |
children.translated_text: [<s>Pradhāna</s> is] not [meant] because of the grouping of the [Sāṃkhya] categories, for there is diversity [in the Upaniṣadic enumeration] and excess [of numbers over the <s>Sāṃkhya</s> scheme] (BS 1.4.11)
<s>Prāṇa</s> and the rest [mentioned in the Upaniṣads are created entities], because of the remainder of the passage [which so states] (BS 1.4.12)
[The creation of <s>prāṇa</s> and others begins] with light, [as stated] by some [recensions], when food [has not yet been created] (BS 1.4.13)
And because [<s>Brahman</s>] is designated as the cause in [the passages about] <s>ākāśa</s> and the rest, as stated [in those very passages] (BS 1.4.14)
Because of the drawing together [of all entities into <s>Brahman</s> at dissolution] (BS 1.4.15)
Because [the term <s>avyakta</s>] denotes the world [and not <s>Sāṃkhya</s>'s <s>Pradhāna</s>] (BS 1.4.16)
If [it be said that <s>Brahman</s> is] not [meant] because of the marks of the individual soul and the chief vital air, [we say] that has been explained (BS 1.4.17)

children.text: anyārthaṃ tu jaiminiḥ praśnavyākhyānābhyām api caivam eke | BBs_1,4.18 |
children.translated_text: But <s>Jaimini</s> [holds that the passage has] another meaning, because of the question and explanation; and some [teach] thus also (BS 1.4.18)
Because of the syntactical connection [of the passage with <s>Brahman</s>] (BS 1.4.19)
<s>Āśmarathya</s> [holds that the soul is] an indicatory mark [of <s>Brahman</s>], because of the fulfilment of the proposition (BS 1.4.20)

children.text: utkramiṣyata evaṃ bhāvād ity auḍulomiḥ | BBs_1,4.21 |
children.translated_text: [The individual soul will] depart [from the body] with such a nature — thus [says] <s>Auḍulomi</s> (BS 1.4.21)
Because of [the individual soul's ultimate] abiding [in <s>Brahman</s>] — thus [says] <s>Kāśakṛtsna</s> (BS 1.4.22)
And [<s>Brahman</s> is] the material cause (<s>Prakṛti</s>), because this does not contradict the proposition, illustration, and [other parts of the teaching] (BS 1.4.23)
And because of the teaching of [<s>Brahman</s>'s] will to create (<s>abhidhyāna</s>) (BS 1.4.24)
And because [<s>Brahman</s> as the material cause] is directly stated in both [the Upaniṣadic] traditions (BS 1.4.25)
Because of [the universe being] the creation of the self [<s>Brahman</s>], through transformation (BS 1.4.26)
And because [<s>Brahman</s>] is declared to be the source (<s>yoni</s>) (BS 1.4.27)
By this, all [other theories attributing the cause to something other than <s>Brahman</s>] are explained, are explained (BS 1.4.28)

If [it be said that there is] the fault of leaving no room for [<s>Sāṃkhya</s>] <s>Smṛti</s>, [we say] no, because [accepting <s>Sāṃkhya</s>] would equally leave no room for other <s>Smṛtis</s> (BS 2.1.1)
And because the [categories] of the others [i.e. <s>Sāṃkhya</s>] are not perceived [in scripture] (BS 2.1.2)
By this, [the] <s>Yoga</s> [system is also] refuted (BS 2.1.3)

children.text: na vilakṣaṇatvād asya tathātvaṃ ca śabdāt | BBs_2,1.4 |
children.translated_text: [The world is] not [different from <s>Brahman</s>] because of the dissimilarity of this [world from <s>Brahman</s>], and its being so [i.e. non-different] is [established] from scripture (BS 2.1.4)
But the designation of the one possessing self-identification (<s>abhimānin</s>) is due to distinction and connection. | BBs_2,1.5 |
But it is seen (in the world). | BBs_2,1.6 |

children.text: asad iti cen na pratiṣedhamātratvāt | BBs_2,1.7 |
children.translated_text: If it be said that (the effect was) non-existent (before creation), no, because (the negation is) merely a denial (of the manifest form). | BBs_2,1.7 |
(If the effect is identical with the cause,) upon dissolution (<s>apīti</s>) there would be the undesirable consequence of the same (defect), hence (the doctrine would be) inconsistent. | BBs_2,1.8 |
But (the objection is) not (valid), because of the existence of an analogy. | BBs_2,1.9 |
And because of the defect in one's own position. | BBs_2,1.10 |

children.text: tarkāpratiṣṭhānād apy anyathānumeyam iti ced evam apy anirmokṣaprasaṅgaḥ | BBs_2,1.11 |
children.translated_text: If it be said that since reasoning has no firm foundation, (the matter) should be inferred otherwise — even so, there would be the undesirable consequence of no liberation. | BBs_2,1.11 |
By this, (doctrines) not accepted by the learned are also explained. | BBs_2,1.12 |

children.text: bhoktrāpatter avibhāgaś cet syāl lokavat | BBs_2,1.13 |
children.translated_text: If (it be said that there would be) non-distinction because the experiencer (<s>bhoktṛ</s>) would be affected, (we say) it would be as in the world. | BBs_2,1.13 |
The non-difference of that (effect from the cause is established) from the words 'origin' (<s>ārambhaṇa</s>) and so on. | BBs_2,1.14 |
And because (the effect) is perceived when (the cause) exists. | BBs_2,1.15 |
And because the other (i.e., the effect) has being (<s>sattva</s>). | BBs_2,1.16 |

children.text: asadvyapadeśān neti cen na dharmāntareṇa vākyaśeṣāt | BBs_2,1.17 |
children.translated_text: If it be said 'not so' because of the designation as non-existent — no, because (it is spoken) in a different sense, as (seen from) the remainder of the sentence. | BBs_2,1.17 |
And because of reasoning and another scriptural text. | BBs_2,1.18 |
And like a cloth. | BBs_2,1.19 |
And as (in the case of) <s>prāṇa</s> (vital breath) and so on. | BBs_2,1.20 |
From the designation of the other (as creator), there would follow the defect of not acting for a purpose and so on. | BBs_2,1.21 |
But (Brahman is) something more, because of the declaration of difference. | BBs_2,1.22 |
And like stone and the like, that (independent creation by the individual soul) is impossible. | BBs_2,1.23 |

children.text: upasaṃhāradarśanān neti cen na kṣīravad dhi | BBs_2,1.24 |
children.translated_text: If it be said 'not so' because (creation requires) assembling of materials — no, because it is like milk. | BBs_2,1.24 |
And as with gods (<s>deva</s>) and others in the world. | BBs_2,1.25 |
Either the consequence of (the cause transforming) entirely, or a contradiction of the statement of (Brahman being) without parts. | BBs_2,1.26 |
But from scripture, because (Brahman's nature) is rooted in the word (of revelation). | BBs_2,1.27 |

children.text: ātmani caivaṃ vicitrāś ca hi | BBs_2,1.28 |
children.translated_text: And thus in the Self, for (there are) indeed diverse (powers). | BBs_2,1.28 |
And because of the defect in one's own position. | BBs_2,1.29 |
And (<s>Brahman</s> is) possessed of all (powers), because that is seen (in scripture). | BBs_2,1.30 |

children.text: vikaraṇatvān neti cet tad uktam | BBs_2,1.31 |
children.translated_text: If it be said 'not so' because (Brahman) is without instruments of action — that has (already) been answered. | BBs_2,1.31 |
Not (purposeless), because of having a purpose. | BBs_2,1.32 |
But (creation is) merely sport (<s>līlā</s>), as in the world. | BBs_2,1.33 |

children.text: vaiṣamyanairghṛṇye na sāpekṣatvāt tathā hi darśayati | BBs_2,1.34 |
children.translated_text: Inequality and cruelty (cannot be charged against God), because He has regard (to <s>karma</s>); for so (scripture) shows. | BBs_2,1.34 |

children.text: na karmāvibhāgād iti cen nānāditvād | BBs_2,1.35 |
children.translated_text: If it be said that (this is) not (possible) because of the non-differentiation of <s>karma</s> (before the first creation) — no, because of (the cycle being) beginningless. | BBs_2,1.35 |
And (this) is reasonable and is also observed. | BBs_2,1.36 |
And because all attributes are established (in <s>Brahman</s>). | BBs_2,1.37 |
And (the <s>pradhāna</s> of <s>Sāṃkhya</s>) is not (the cause) through inference, because of the impossibility of (explaining intelligent) design. | BBs_2,2.1 |
And because of (the impossibility of explaining) activity. | BBs_2,2.2 |
If (it be said that the <s>pradhāna</s> acts) like milk or water — even in that case (the objection applies). | BBs_2,2.3 |
And because the separation (of the three <s>guṇas</s>) has no fixed rule, and because (the <s>pradhāna</s>) is independent (of any guiding intelligence). | BBs_2,2.4 |
And because of the absence (of purpose) elsewhere, (the analogy with) grass and the like does not hold. | BBs_2,2.5 |
Even if (the <s>Sāṃkhya</s> doctrine be) conceded, (it fails) because of the absence of purpose. | BBs_2,2.6 |
If (it be said that the relation of <s>puruṣa</s> and <s>pradhāna</s> is) like (that of) a person and a stone (i.e., a magnet) — even then (the difficulty remains). | BBs_2,2.7 |
And because of the impossibility of (the <s>pradhāna</s>) being a subordinate part. | BBs_2,2.8 |
And if (the existence of <s>pradhāna</s> be) inferred otherwise, (it fails) because of the disconnection from knowledge and power. | BBs_2,2.9 |
And (the <s>Sāṃkhya</s> system is) inconsistent because of mutual contradictions. | BBs_2,2.10 |
Or like (the production of) the great (<s>mahat</s>) and the long, from the short and the atomic — (the <s>Vaiśeṣika</s> view is untenable). | BBs_2,2.11 |
In either case, action does not (arise) from those (atoms); hence that (creation) is impossible. | BBs_2,2.12 |
And because of the acceptance of <s>samavāya</s> (inherence), from the equal (need for a further relation), there is an infinite regress. | BBs_2,2.13 |
And because (the atoms are) always (of the same nature), (creation) would be permanent. | BBs_2,2.14 |
And because (atoms) possess form and other (qualities), the reverse (i.e., their non-eternality) is seen. | BBs_2,2.15 |
And in either case, (there is) a defect. | BBs_2,2.16 |
And because (the <s>Vaiśeṣika</s> doctrine is) not accepted (by the wise), there is complete disregard. | BBs_2,2.17 |
Even if both (atoms and <s>adṛṣṭa</s>) are causes of the aggregate, that (creation) is not attained. | BBs_2,2.18 |
If it be said that (it is valid) because of the mutual dependence (of cause and effect) — no, because (one is) merely the occasional cause of origination. | BBs_2,2.19 |
And upon the arising of the later (moment), the earlier is destroyed. | BBs_2,2.20 |
If (the self is) non-existent, there is abandonment of the thesis; (if existent,) simultaneity or otherwise (follows). | BBs_2,2.21 |
Neither analytical (<s>pratisaṃkhyā</s>) nor non-analytical (<s>apratisaṃkhyā</s>) cessation is attainable, because of non-interruption. | BBs_2,2.22 |
And in either case, (there is) a defect. | BBs_2,2.23 |
And regarding <s>ākāśa</s> (space), because of no distinction (from other produced things, the Buddhist view fails). | BBs_2,2.24 |
And because of memory (presupposing a persistent self). | BBs_2,2.25 |
Not from non-existence, because it is not seen. | BBs_2,2.26 |
And even for those who are indifferent, the same conclusion holds. | BBs_2,2.27 |
(The external world is) not non-existent, because it is perceived. | BBs_2,2.28 |
And because of the dissimilarity (between waking and dream states, the world is) not like dreams and the like. | BBs_2,2.29 |
(External objects) do not exist (according to the Yogācāra Buddhist) — (this is) not (correct), because of (their) perception. | BBs_2,2.30 |
And because of momentariness. | BBs_2,2.31 |
And because (the Buddhist view) is in every way untenable. | BBs_2,2.32 |
Not in a single (soul can all experiences reside), because of the impossibility. | BBs_2,2.33 |
And thus the self would be incomplete. | BBs_2,2.34 |

children.text: na ca paryāyād apy avirodho vikārādibhyaḥ | BBs_2,2.35 |
children.translated_text: And not even by (the doctrine of) alternation is there non-contradiction, because of transformation and other (difficulties). | BBs_2,2.35 |
And because of the permanence of the final state, and because both (bondage and liberation) would be eternal, there is no distinction (in the <s>Jaina</s> view). | BBs_2,2.36 |
Because of the inconsistency regarding the Lord (<s>pati</s>) (in the <s>Pāśupata</s> doctrine). | BBs_2,2.37 |
And because of the impossibility of (establishing a) relation. | BBs_2,2.38 |
And because of the impossibility of (God being) the substratum. | BBs_2,2.39 |
If (it be said that God is the cause) like an instrument — no, because of experience and the like (requiring a conscious agent). | BBs_2,2.40 |
(God would be) either finite or not omniscient. | BBs_2,2.41 |
Because of the impossibility of origination (of the soul from God in the <s>Bhāgavata</s> view). | BBs_2,2.42 |
And the agent (<s>kartṛ</s>) cannot become the instrument (<s>karaṇa</s>). | BBs_2,2.43 |
Or if (the fourfold nature of) consciousness (<s>vijñāna</s>) and the rest exists, there is no denial of that (the Lord). | BBs_2,2.44 |
And because of contradictions. | BBs_2,2.45 |
<s>Ākāśa</s> (space) (is) not (created), because there is no scriptural statement. | BBs_2,3.1 |
But it exists (i.e., it is created, as scripture declares). | BBs_2,3.2 |
Because a secondary (figurative) meaning is impossible. | BBs_2,3.3 |
And because of the (Vedic) word. | BBs_2,3.4 |
And it may be (that the word denoting <s>ākāśa</s> refers to <s>Brahman</s>) as (happens with) a single word like '<s>Brahman</s>.' | BBs_2,3.5 |
There would be abandonment of the thesis and non-distinction, from the (Vedic) words. | BBs_2,3.6 |
But the division (of elements persists) as far as (there is) modification, as in the world. | BBs_2,3.7 |
By this, <s>Mātariśvan</s> (air, <s>Vāyu</s>) is explained. | BBs_2,3.8 |
But non-origination (of that which already exists) is impossible, because of the illogicality (of something existent being born again). | BBs_2,3.9 |
<s>Tejas</s> (fire) (is created) from that (<s>Vāyu</s>); for so (scripture) says. | BBs_2,3.10 |
(Then) water (<s>āpas</s>). | BBs_2,3.11 |
Earth (<s>pṛthivī</s>), because of the subject matter, form, and other scriptural words. | BBs_2,3.12 |

children.text: tadabhidhyānād eva tu talliṅgāt saḥ | BBs_2,3.13 |
children.translated_text: Because of His meditation (<s>abhidhyāna</s>) alone, (creation takes place); from the indicatory mark of that, He (is the creator). | BBs_2,3.13 |

children.text: viparyayeṇa tu kramo 'ta upapadyate ca | BBs_2,3.14 |
children.translated_text: But in the reverse order (is) the sequence (of dissolution) from that; and (this) is reasonable. | BBs_2,3.14 |

children.text: antarā vijñānamanasī krameṇa talliṅgād iti cen nāviśeṣāt | BBs_2,3.15 |
children.translated_text: If it be said that <s>vijñāna</s> (intelligence) and <s>manas</s> (mind are created) in between, in order, because of the indicatory mark of that — no, because of no (such) distinction (in scripture). | BBs_2,3.15 |

children.text: carācaravyapāśrayas tu syāt tadvyapadeśo bhāktas tadbhāvabhāvitvāt | BBs_2,3.16 |
children.translated_text: But (the creation) depends on the moving and non-moving; the designation of that (as sentient) is figurative (<s>bhākta</s>), because it arises from the existence of that (sentient being). | BBs_2,3.16 |

children.text: nātmā śruter nityatvāc ca tābhyaḥ | BBs_2,3.17 |
children.translated_text: The self (<s>ātman</s>) is not (created), because of scripture and because of (its) eternality, from those (scriptural texts). | BBs_2,3.17 |
(The self is) a knower (<s>jña</s>), for that very reason. | BBs_2,3.18 |
(The self is not atomic or all-pervading) because of (the facts of) departure, going, and returning. | BBs_2,3.19 |
And with respect to the latter two (going and returning), by its own self. | BBs_2,3.20 |
If it be said that (the self is) not atomic because of scriptural statements to the contrary — no, because (those statements) refer to the other (i.e., the Supreme Self). | BBs_2,3.21 |
And because of (its being designated by) its own term and measure. | BBs_2,3.22 |
There is no contradiction, like sandal paste. | BBs_2,3.23 |

children.text: avasthitivaiśeṣyād iti cen nābhyupagamād dhṛdi hi | BBs_2,3.24 |
children.translated_text: If it be said (there is a difficulty) because of the particular location — no, because of the acceptance (in scripture) that (the self resides) in the heart. | BBs_2,3.24 |
Or on account of a quality (<s>guṇa</s>), as in the world. | BBs_2,3.25 |
The separateness (of the self from the body is) like fragrance (from the earth). | BBs_2,3.26 |
And so (scripture) shows. | BBs_2,3.27 |
Because of the separate teaching (of the self and the <s>prāṇas</s>). | BBs_2,3.28 |
But the designation of that (self as of the nature of intelligence) is because its essence is that quality, like (the designation of) the Supreme (<s>Prājña</s>). | BBs_2,3.29 |

children.text: yāvadātmabhāvitvāc ca na doṣas taddarśanāt | BBs_2,3.30 |
children.translated_text: And there is no defect, because (knowledge) lasts as long as the self lasts; for so (scripture) shows. | BBs_2,3.30 |
But like masculinity and the like, (knowledge) of this (self) is (merely) a manifestation of what already exists. | BBs_2,3.31 |
Otherwise, the undesirable consequence of perpetual perception or perpetual non-perception, or the limitation to one of the two. | BBs_2,3.32 |
The (individual self is the) agent (<s>kartā</s>), because of the purposefulness of the scriptures. | BBs_2,3.33 |
Because of the teaching of (modes of) conduct. | BBs_2,3.34 |
Because of (the self being described as) taking up (the senses). | BBs_2,3.35 |

children.text: vyapadeśāc ca kriyāyāṃ na cen nirdeśaviparyayaḥ | BBs_2,3.36 |
children.translated_text: And because of the designation (of the self) in connection with action; if not, there would be a reversal of the statement. | BBs_2,3.36 |
Like perception, there is no fixed rule (regarding agency). | BBs_2,3.37 |
Because of the reversal of power (agency depends on the Lord). | BBs_2,3.38 |
And because of the absence of <s>samādhi</s> (otherwise). | BBs_2,3.39 |
And like a carpenter, in both ways. | BBs_2,3.40 |
But (agency) is from the Supreme (<s>Para</s>), because of the scriptural statement of that. | BBs_2,3.41 |
But (the Lord) has regard to (individual) effort, because of the purposefulness of injunctions and prohibitions and the like. | BBs_2,3.42 |

children.text: aṃśo nānāvyapadeśād anyathā cāpi dāśakitavāditvam adhīyata eke | BBs_2,3.43 |
children.translated_text: (The individual self is) a part (<s>aṃśa</s>), because of the manifold designations; and otherwise, some read (a passage implying that Brahman would be subject to the nature of) a fisherman, gambler, and so on. | BBs_2,3.43 |
And because of the words of the <s>mantras</s>. | BBs_2,3.44 |
And moreover, <s>smṛti</s> (tradition) states (this). | BBs_2,3.45 |
Like light and such, the Supreme is not thus (affected). | BBs_2,3.46 |
And <s>smṛti</s> texts declare (this). | BBs_2,3.47 |
Permission and prohibition (are possible) because of the connection with the body, like light and the like. | BBs_2,3.48 |
And because of non-continuity (of the self with other selves), there is no intermixture. | BBs_2,3.49 |
And (the individual soul is) merely a reflection (<s>ābhāsa</s>). | BBs_2,3.50 |
Because there is no fixed rule regarding <s>adṛṣṭa</s> (unseen merit and demerit). | BBs_2,3.51 |
And so also in the case of intention (<s>abhisandhi</s>) and the like. | BBs_2,3.52 |
If it be said (there is a difficulty) because of location — no, because of (the self being) contained within (Brahman). | BBs_2,3.53 |
Similarly (are created) the <s>prāṇas</s> (vital breaths). | BBs_2,4.1 |
Because a secondary (figurative) meaning is impossible. | BBs_2,4.2 |
And because of the prior scriptural statement of that (creation). | BBs_2,4.3 |
Speech (<s>vāc</s>) (is created) because it is preceded by that (<s>prāṇa</s>). | BBs_2,4.4 |
Seven (are the <s>prāṇas</s>), because of (the scriptural mode of) going and because of specification. | BBs_2,4.5 |
But the hands and other (organs of action) exist even when (the self) remains (in the body); hence not so (i.e., they are not <s>prāṇas</s> in the primary sense). | BBs_2,4.6 |
And (the <s>prāṇas</s> are) atomic (in size). | BBs_2,4.7 |
And the chief (<s>prāṇa</s>, <s>śreṣṭha</s>) (is also created). | BBs_2,4.8 |
(The chief <s>prāṇa</s>) is neither air (<s>Vāyu</s>) nor function, because of the separate teaching. | BBs_2,4.9 |
But (the chief <s>prāṇa</s>) is like the eye and other (senses), because of the teaching of (its) co-creation and the like. | BBs_2,4.10 |

children.text: akaraṇatvāc ca na doṣas tathā hi darśayati | BBs_2,4.11 |
children.translated_text: And there is no defect because of (its) not being an instrument of (specific) action; for so (scripture) shows. | BBs_2,4.11 |
(The chief <s>prāṇa</s>) has five functions, and is designated like the mind (<s>manas</s>). | BBs_2,4.12 |
And [the soul is] atomic. | BBs 2.4.13 |
But [its] presiding over light and the rest is due to [its] thinking [through them]. | BBs 2.4.14 |
[It is connected] with that which possesses <s>Prāṇa</s> (the vital breath), because of the scriptural word. | BBs 2.4.15 |
And because of its eternality. | BBs 2.4.16 |

children.text: ta indriyāṇi tadvyapadeśād anyatra śreṣṭhāt | BBs_2,4.17 |
children.translated_text: Those are the sense-organs (<s>indriyas</s>), because of their being so designated, except for the chief [<s>Prāṇa</s>]. | BBs 2.4.17 |
Because of the scriptural declaration of difference. | BBs 2.4.18 |
And because of the dissimilarity of characteristics. | BBs 2.4.19 |
But the arrangement of names and forms is [the work] of the one who performs the tripartite division (<s>trivṛtkaraṇa</s>), because of the teaching [to that effect]. | BBs 2.4.20 |
Flesh and the like are earthy, as stated in scripture; and similarly for the other two [elements]. | BBs 2.4.21 |
But because of predominance, the designation is thus — the designation is thus. | BBs 2.4.22 |
In the obtaining of another [body], the [soul] departs, enveloped [by the subtle elements], as known from the question and the explanation. | BBs 3.1.1 |
But because of the tripartite nature [of elements], [the soul's departure is] with the predominant one. | BBs 3.1.2 |
And because of the departure of <s>Prāṇa</s>. | BBs 3.1.3 |

children.text: agnyādigatiśruter iti cen na bhāktatvāt | BBs_3,1.4 |
children.translated_text: If it be said [that the soul goes] to fire and the rest, because of the scriptural statement of such a path — no, because it is figurative. | BBs 3.1.4 |

children.text: prathame 'śravaṇād iti cen na tā eva hy upapatteḥ | BBs_3,1.5 |
children.translated_text: If it be said that [water is] not heard of in the first [oblation] — no, because those very [waters] are meant, as is reasonable. | BBs 3.1.5 |

children.text: aśrutatvād iti cen neṣṭādikāriṇāṃ pratīteḥ | BBs_3,1.6 |
children.translated_text: If it be said that it is not mentioned [in scripture] — no, because of the recognition of those who perform the <s>iṣṭā</s> (sacrifice) and the like. | BBs 3.1.6 |

children.text: bhāktaṃ vānātmavittvāt tathā hi darśayati | BBs_3,1.7 |
children.translated_text: Or it is figurative, because of [the reference to those who are] not knowers of the Self; for thus [scripture] shows. | BBs 3.1.7 |

When the [effects of] deeds are exhausted, [the soul], together with the residual impressions (<s>anuśaya</s>), [returns], as known from direct statement and inference; thus and not otherwise. | BBs 3.1.8 |

children.text: caraṇād iti cen nopalakṣaṇārtheti kārṣṇājiniḥ | BBs_3,1.9 |
children.translated_text: If it be said [that this applies to those with] good conduct (<s>caraṇa</s>) — no, [it is meant] as an indicatory term, so says <s>Kārṣṇājini</s>. | BBs 3.1.9 |

children.text: ānarthakyam iti cen na tadapekṣatvāt | BBs_3,1.10 |
children.translated_text: If it be said that [good conduct] would be purposeless — no, because [the result] depends on that. | BBs 3.1.10 |
But [<s>caraṇa</s> means] good and bad deeds alone, so says <s>Bādari</s>. | BBs 3.1.11 |
And it is stated in scripture also regarding those who perform undesirable [actions] and the like. | BBs 3.1.12 |

children.text: saṃyamane tv anubhūyetareṣāmārohāv arohau tadgatidarśanāt | BBs_3,1.13 |
children.translated_text: But in [the realm of] <s>Yama</s> (the lord of death), having experienced [the results], for the others the ascent and descent [occur], because scripture shows that path. | BBs 3.1.13 |
And the <s>smṛtis</s> (traditional texts) also state [this]. | BBs 3.1.14 |
Moreover, [there are] seven [hells]. | BBs 3.1.15 |
And even there, there is no contradiction, because of the operation of that [<s>karma</s>]. | BBs 3.1.16 |
But [the two paths are] for knowledge and works, because that is the subject under discussion. | BBs 3.1.17 |
Not in the third [path is this so], because [scripture] is found [to say otherwise]. | BBs 3.1.18 |
And it is remembered also in the world. | BBs 3.1.19 |
And because it is seen [in scripture]. | BBs 3.1.20 |
The inclusion in the third term [applies to] one born of the mixture [of good and evil deeds]. | BBs 3.1.21 |
[There is the possibility of] attaining that nature, because it is reasonable. | BBs 3.1.22 |
Not after a long time, because of a special [reason]. | BBs 3.1.23 |
In [bodies] presided over by others, as before, because of the statement. | BBs 3.1.24 |

children.text: aśuddham iti cen na śabdāt | BBs_3,1.25 |
children.translated_text: If it be said [the descent is] impure — no, because of the scriptural word. | BBs 3.1.25 |
Then there is union with the semen. | BBs 3.1.26 |
From the womb [comes] the body. | BBs 3.1.27 |
In the intermediate state [of dream], [there is] creation; for [scripture] says so. | BBs 3.2.1 |
And some [say] a creator [exists there]; also sons and others [are created]. | BBs 3.2.2 |
But [the dream world is] mere <s>māyā</s> (illusion), because the [dreamer's] true nature is not fully manifested. | BBs 3.2.3 |

children.text: sūcakaśca hi śruter ācakṣate ca tadvidaḥ | BBs_3,2.4 |
children.translated_text: And [dream is] indicative, for scripture states [so], and the knowers of that declare [the same]. | BBs 3.2.4 |

children.text: parābhidhyānāt tu tirohitaṃ tato hy asya bandhaviparyayau | BBs_3,2.5 |
children.translated_text: But by the supreme meditation [of the Lord], [the soul's real nature] is hidden; for from Him arise its bondage and the opposite [liberation]. | BBs 3.2.5 |
Or that [concealment] also [arises] from the connection with the body. | BBs 3.2.6 |

children.text: tadabhāvo nāḍīṣu tacchruter ātmani ca | BBs_3,2.7 |
children.translated_text: The absence of that [dream] is in the <s>nāḍīs</s> (subtle channels), because of the scriptural statement to that effect; and in the Self. | BBs 3.2.7 |
Therefore, awakening is from that [Self]. | BBs 3.2.8 |
But it is the same [soul that wakes], because of [the scriptural statements regarding] <s>karma</s>, memory, word, and injunction. | BBs 3.2.9 |
In a swoon, there is a half-attainment [of the state of deep sleep], by the method of residues. | BBs 3.2.10 |

children.text: na sthānato 'pi parasyobhayaliṅgaṃ sarvatra hi | BBs_3,2.11 |
children.translated_text: Not even from [the difference of] location [can] the Supreme [<s>Brahman</s>] have the twofold characteristic, for [it is present] everywhere. | BBs 3.2.11 |

children.text: na bhedād iti cen na pratyekam atadvacanāt | BBs_3,2.12 |
children.translated_text: If it be said [that there is contradiction] because of difference [of descriptions] — no, because each individually is stated to be not that [limited thing]. | BBs 3.2.12 |
Moreover, thus indeed [declare] some [scriptures]. | BBs 3.2.13 |
It is formless indeed, for that is the predominant [teaching]. | BBs 3.2.14 |
And like light, [form is attributed] for a purpose [i.e., it is not purposeless]. | BBs 3.2.15 |
[Scripture] says that much only. | BBs 3.2.16 |
[Scripture] shows [it], and moreover it is remembered [in <s>smṛti</s>]. | BBs 3.2.17 |
For this very reason, the simile is like the sun and similar [things]. | BBs 3.2.18 |
But [<s>Brahman</s> is] not so [i.e., not affected], like water, because of the non-grasping. | BBs 3.2.19 |
[The attributions of] increase and decrease are figurative; because of the inclusion [of the soul in <s>Brahman</s>], and the consistency of both [views] — thus it is. | BBs 3.2.20 |
And because it is seen [in scripture]. | BBs 3.2.21 |

children.text: prakṛtaitāvattvaṃ hi pratiṣedhati tato bravīti ca bhūyaḥ | BBs_3,2.22 |
children.translated_text: Indeed, [scripture] negates [the soul's being] limited to its apparent nature, and then speaks further. | BBs 3.2.22 |
[Scripture] says that [<s>Brahman</s>] is unmanifest. | BBs 3.2.23 |
Moreover, in [complete] devotion, [<s>Brahman</s> becomes known] through direct perception and inference. | BBs 3.2.24 |
And like light and the like, there is non-distinction; and the light [of knowledge comes] through the practice of action. | BBs 3.2.25 |
Therefore, [<s>Brahman</s> is connected] with the infinite; for thus is the indicatory mark. | BBs 3.2.26 |
But because of the twofold designation, [the relation between <s>Brahman</s> and the soul is] like [that of] a serpent and its coils. | BBs 3.2.27 |
Or like [the relation of] light to its substratum, because of [<s>Brahman</s>'s] luminous nature. | BBs 3.2.28 |
Or as stated before. | BBs 3.2.29 |
And because of the negation [of all other descriptions]. | BBs 3.2.30 |
From the supreme [<s>Brahman</s>], because of the statements regarding the bridge, measure, connection, and distinction. | BBs 3.2.31 |
But [the descriptions apply] in a general sense. | BBs 3.2.32 |
[The descriptions are] for the purpose of meditation, like the [attribution of] feet. | BBs 3.2.33 |
Because of the difference of location, [<s>Brahman</s> manifests differently,] like light and the like. | BBs 3.2.34 |
And because it is reasonable. | BBs 3.2.35 |
Likewise, because of the negation of the other [descriptions]. | BBs 3.2.36 |
By this, [<s>Brahman</s>'s] omnipresence [is established], from the statements of extent, the word [<s>Brahman</s>], and so forth. | BBs 3.2.37 |
The fruit [comes] from that [<s>Brahman</s>], because it is reasonable. | BBs 3.2.38 |
And because it is stated in scripture. | BBs 3.2.39 |
[The fruit comes from] <s>Dharma</s> (righteous action), so [says] <s>Jaimini</s>; for this very reason. | BBs 3.2.40 |
But the former [view is held by] <s>Bādarāyaṇa</s>, because [<s>Brahman</s>] is designated as the cause. | BBs 3.2.41 |
The cognition [of <s>Brahman</s> taught] in all the <s>Vedānta</s> texts [is one], because of the non-distinction of injunction and the rest. | BBs 3.3.1 |

children.text: bhedān neti cen naikasyām api | BBs_3,3.2 |
children.translated_text: If it be said [that the meditations are] not [one] because of differences — no, because even within a single [<s>Vedānta</s> text], [the same applies]. | BBs 3.3.2 |

children.text: svādhyāyasya tathātvena hi samācāre 'dhikārāc ca savavac ca tanniyamaḥ | BBs_3,3.3 |
children.translated_text: Because the study of one's own [<s>Veda</s>] is thus, since [meditation is performed] in practice, and because of the qualification — and like the <s>savana</s> [rite], that is its rule. | BBs 3.3.3 |
And [scripture] shows [this]. | BBs 3.3.4 |

The combination [of qualities from different texts is appropriate] because of non-difference of meaning; as in the case of a supplementary injunction, and because [the object of meditation is] the same. | BBs 3.3.5 |

children.text: anyathātvaṃ śabdād iti cen nāviśeṣāt | BBs_3,3.6 |
children.translated_text: If it be said [that the meditations are] different because of the words — no, because of the non-distinction [of meaning]. | BBs 3.3.6 |
Or [the meditations are] not [to be combined], because of the difference of context, like the superior and the inferior [<s>sāmans</s>] and the like. | BBs 3.3.7 |

children.text: saṃjñātaś cet tad uktam asti tu tad api | BBs_3,3.8 |
children.translated_text: If [it be said that the difference is only] of name — that has been stated; but that also [needs consideration]. | BBs 3.3.8 |
And because of pervasion, it is consistent. | BBs 3.3.9 |
Because of the non-difference of all, the others are [included] in these. | BBs 3.3.10 |
Bliss and the other [attributes belong] to the principal [<s>Brahman</s>]. | BBs 3.3.11 |

[If the qualities were not combined,] there would be non-attainment of the dear-headedness and the like, and increase and decrease [of attributes] in [each meditation treated as] different. | BBs 3.3.12 |
But the others [are to be combined], because of the sameness of meaning. | BBs 3.3.13 |
Because there is no purpose in mere repeated meditation [without combining]. | BBs 3.3.14 |
And because of the word 'Self.' | BBs 3.3.15 |
The understanding of the Self [as <s>Brahman</s>] is like the other [meditations], from the subsequent [passage]. | BBs 3.3.16 |

children.text: anvayād iti cet syād avadhāraṇāt | BBs_3,3.17 |
children.translated_text: If it be said [that the identity is established] from the continuity [of the text] — [it would follow that] it should be so from the definite statement. | BBs 3.3.17 |
Because of the mention of the effect, [the meditation on the five-fire doctrine] is new. | BBs 3.3.18 |
It is the same, and thus [there is] non-difference. | BBs 3.3.19 |
Because of the connection, thus in other [cases] also. | BBs 3.3.20 |
Or not, because of the specific [difference]. | BBs 3.3.21 |
And [scripture] shows [this]. | BBs 3.3.22 |
Abundance, heaven, and pervasion also [are to be combined], for this [reason]. | BBs 3.3.23 |
As in the <s>Puruṣavidyā</s> (meditation on the Person), since the others are not mentioned. | BBs 3.3.24 |
Because of the difference of purpose, such as piercing and the like. | BBs 3.3.25 |

children.text: hānau tūpāyanaśabdaśeṣatvāt kuśāc chandaḥstutyupagānavat tad uktam | BBs_3,3.26 |
children.translated_text: In the case of [the instruction] to give up [certain practices], because [those words] are a remainder of the word 'approach,' like [the carrying of] <s>kuśa</s> grass, [the singing of] meters, hymns of praise, and chanting — this has been stated. | BBs 3.3.26 |

children.text: sāṃparāye tartavyābhāvāt tathā hy anye | BBs_3,3.27 |
children.translated_text: At the time of death, there is nothing to be crossed [by one who has this knowledge]; for thus [declare] others. | BBs 3.3.27 |
At will, because of the non-contradiction of both. | BBs 3.3.28 |

children.text: gater arthavattvam ubhayathānyathā hi virodhaḥ | BBs_3,3.29 |
children.translated_text: The journey [of the soul after death] has a purpose in both ways; otherwise there would be contradiction. | BBs 3.3.29 |
It is reasonable, because the object having such characteristics is found, as in the world. | BBs 3.3.30 |
There is no restriction [to a particular meditation]; all [meditations] are non-contradictory, from scripture and inference. | BBs 3.3.31 |
Those belonging to a [particular] qualification remain as long as the qualification lasts. | BBs 3.3.32 |

But the inclusion of the meditations on the syllable [<s>Om</s>] is because of the general [nature] and its being that, as in the case of the <s>Upasad</s> [rites] — this has been stated. | BBs 3.3.33 |
Because this much is acknowledged [in scripture]. | BBs 3.3.34 |
In the intermediate [state, the soul is] like the group of elements, by its own Self. | BBs 3.3.35 |

children.text: anyathā bhedānupapattir iti cen nopadeśāntaravat | BBs_3,3.36 |
children.translated_text: If it be said that otherwise the difference would be inexplicable — no, as in the case of another teaching. | BBs 3.3.36 |
The interchange [of qualities is to be made]; for [scripture] distinguishes, as in other cases. | BBs 3.3.37 |
That itself [is <s>Brahman</s>], indeed — [it is] truth and the rest. | BBs 3.3.38 |
Desire and the rest [are to be combined] in the other [meditation] also, because of [the mention of] the abode and the like therein. | BBs 3.3.39 |
Because of the importance [of the meditation], there is no omission. | BBs 3.3.40 |
When [the Self] is present, because of the statement to that effect. | BBs 3.3.41 |
There is no restriction in the determination of that [meditation]; because that [flexibility] is seen, and because the absence of connection with each separately is the fruit. | BBs 3.3.42 |
Just as in the case of offering — this has been stated. | BBs 3.3.43 |

children.text: liṅgabhūyastvāt tad dhi balīyas tad api | BBs_3,3.44 |
children.translated_text: Because of the preponderance of indicatory marks, for that is stronger — and that also. | BBs 3.3.44 |
The former alternative [applies], because of the context; it should be like [the rite] being performed. | BBs 3.3.45 |
And because of the extension [of the rule]. | BBs 3.3.46 |
But it is knowledge alone [that is the means], because of the definite statement. | BBs 3.3.47 |
And because [scripture] shows [this]. | BBs 3.3.48 |
And because of the greater strength of scripture and the like, there is no sublation. | BBs 3.3.49 |
Because of the connection and the rest, [meditation is] separate like another cognition; and it is seen [thus] — this has been stated. | BBs 3.3.50 |
Not even from a general [rule is there a restriction], because of the finding [in scripture]; like [the concept of] death — for [it does] not [apply] in worldly convention. | BBs 3.3.51 |

children.text: pareṇa ca śabdasya tādvidhyaṃ bhūyastvāt tv anubandhaḥ | BBs_3,3.52 |
children.translated_text: And the word has that character in relation to the Supreme; but because of the preponderance [of evidence], the connection [is maintained]. | BBs 3.3.52 |
There is one [Self] in the body of a [living being], because of existence. | BBs 3.3.53 |

The distinction [between the individual self and <s>Brahman</s> is maintained] because [the individual self] exists where that [<s>Brahman</s>] exists; but not like [the distinctness of] perception. | BBs 3.3.54 |

children.text: aṅgāvabaddhāstu na śākhāsu hi prativedam | BBs_3,3.55 |
children.translated_text: But [meditations] that are subsidiary parts are not [different] in the [various] branches, for [they are found] in each <s>Veda</s>. // <s>BBs</s> 3,3.55 //
As with <s>mantras</s> and the like, there is no contradiction. // <s>BBs</s> 3,3.56 //

children.text: bhūmnaḥ kratuvajjyāyas tvaṃ tathā hi darśayati | BBs_3,3.57 |
children.translated_text: The superiority [belongs to] the fuller [meditation], as with sacrifices; for so [the scripture] shows. // <s>BBs</s> 3,3.57 //
Because of differences in words and other [features, they are] diverse. // <s>BBs</s> 3,3.58 //
There is an option, because of the non-difference of the fruit. // <s>BBs</s> 3,3.59 //

children.text: kāmyās tu yathākāmaṃ samuccīyeran na vā pūrvahetvabhāvāt | BBs_3,3.60 |
children.translated_text: But optional [meditations] may or may not be combined as one wishes, because the previous reason does not apply. // <s>BBs</s> 3,3.60 //
In the subsidiary parts, [the meditations exist] according to [the nature of their] basis. // <s>BBs</s> 3,3.61 //
And because of the injunction. // <s>BBs</s> 3,3.62 //
Because of the aggregation. // <s>BBs</s> 3,3.63 //
And because of the scriptural teaching of the commonality of qualities. // <s>BBs</s> 3,3.64 //
Or not, because of the absence of scriptural teaching of their coexistence. // <s>BBs</s> 3,3.65 //
And because of [scriptural] showing. // <s>BBs</s> 3,3.66 //
Knowledge is for the purpose of man, from the [scriptural] word; thus [holds] <s>Bādarāyaṇa</s>. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.1 //

children.text: śeṣatvāt puruṣārthavādo yathānyeṣv iti jaiminiḥ | BBs_3,4.2 |
children.translated_text: Because of its subsidiary nature, [the statement about knowledge] is a human-purpose-statement (<s>arthavāda</s>), as in other [cases]; thus [holds] <s>Jaimini</s>. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.2 //
Because of the observation of conduct. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.3 //
Because of the scriptural teaching of that. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.4 //
Because of the commencement [of action being] equally [taught]. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.5 //
Because of the injunction for one possessing that [knowledge]. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.6 //
And because of the restriction. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.7 //
But because of the additional teaching, [the view] of <s>Bādarāyaṇa</s> [is established] thus, for [scripture] shows that. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.8 //
But the showing is equal. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.9 //
[The injunction of works] is not universal. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.10 //
The division [is] as with the hundredfold [sacrifice]. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.11 //
For one who merely studies. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.12 //
Not [so], because of the absence of distinction. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.13 //
Or the permission is for the sake of praise. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.14 //
And some [hold it is] by free choice. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.15 //
And [there would be] destruction [of rituals]. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.16 //
And for those of ascending [celibate] life, for so the scripture [declares]. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.17 //
<s>Jaimini</s> [considers it] a reference, and the injunction refutes [that], for [scripture declares thus]. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.18 //
[It] is to be performed, [says] <s>Bādarāyaṇa</s>, because of the scriptural teaching of equality. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.19 //
Or [it is] an injunction, like the [injunction of] holding [the sacrificial vessels]. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.20 //

children.text: stutimātram upādānād iti cen nāpūrvatvāt | BBs_3,4.21 |
children.translated_text: If [one says] that because of the adoption [from the context], it is mere praise — no, because of its originality. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.21 //
And because of the word '<s>bhāva</s>' (being). // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.22 //

children.text: pāriplavārthā iti cen na viśeṣitatvāt | BBs_3,4.23 |
children.translated_text: If [one says they are] for the purpose of the <s>pāriplava</s> [recitation] — no, because of their being specified. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.23 //
And also because of the connection in a single sentence. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.24 //
And for this very reason, there is no requirement of kindling the fire and so forth. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.25 //
And [there is] dependence on all [rites], because of the scriptural teaching of sacrifice and the like, as with the horse [sacrifice]. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.26 //

children.text: śamadamādyupetas syāt tathāpi tu tadvidhes tadaṅgatayā teṣām apy avaśyānuṣṭheyatvāt | BBs_3,4.27 |
children.translated_text: One should be endowed with <s>śama</s> (tranquility), <s>dama</s> (self-control), and the rest; even so, since they are subsidiaries of that [knowledge], their performance is also necessarily required. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.27 //

children.text: sarvān nānumatiś ca prāṇātyaye taddarśanāt | BBs_3,4.28 |
children.translated_text: And there is no permission for all [forbidden foods] except when life is in danger, for so [scripture] shows. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.28 //
And because there is no conflict. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.29 //
And moreover, [thus] it is remembered [in the <s>Smṛti</s>]. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.30 //
And the [scriptural] word [is directed] against free choice. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.31 //
And also the duties of the <s>āśramas</s>, because they are enjoined. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.32 //
And as being auxiliary. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.33 //
In every way, these very [duties remain valid], because of the double indication. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.34 //
And [scripture] shows the non-overpowering [of knowledge by sin]. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.35 //
But even in the intermediate [<s>āśramas</s>], for so it is seen. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.36 //
And moreover, [thus] it is remembered [in the <s>Smṛti</s>]. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.37 //
And there is special favor. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.38 //

children.text: atas tv itarajjyāyo liṅgāc ca | BBs_3,4.39 |
children.translated_text: But from this, the other [i.e., the householder's <s>āśrama</s>] is superior, and because of the indicatory mark. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.39 //

children.text: tadbhūtasya tu nātadbhāvo jaiminer api niyamāt tadrūpābhāvebhyaḥ | BBs_3,4.40 |
children.translated_text: But for one who has entered that [<s>āśrama</s>], there is no abandoning it, even according to <s>Jaimini</s>, because of the restriction, since the reasons [for change] are absent. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.40 //

children.text: na cādhikārikam api patanānumānāt tadayogāt | BBs_3,4.41 |
children.translated_text: And it is not even due to qualification, because of the inference of a fall, since that [qualification] does not apply. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.41 //

children.text: upapūrvam api tv eke bhāvamaśanavat tad uktam | BBs_3,4.42 |
children.translated_text: But some [hold] there is [an order of] progression, like the eating of food; that has been stated. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.42 //

children.text: bahis tūbhayathāpi smṛter ācārāc ca | BBs_3,4.43 |
children.translated_text: But outside [the <s>āśramas</s>], in both ways, because of <s>Smṛti</s> and practice. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.43 //
The fruit belongs to the master, because of the scriptural teaching; thus [holds] <s>Ātreya</s>. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.44 //

children.text: ārtvijyam ity auḍulomiḥ tasmai hi parikrīyate | BBs_3,4.45 |
children.translated_text: The priestly office [is the basis]; thus [holds] <s>Auḍulomi</s>; for it is performed for him. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.45 //
And because of scripture. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.46 //

children.text: sahakāryantaravidhiḥ pakṣeṇa tṛtīyaṃ tadvato vidhyādivat | BBs_3,4.47 |
children.translated_text: The injunction of another auxiliary [is operative] alternately as a third [option], as in the case of the injunction for one possessing that [knowledge], and the like. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.47 //
But because of the totality, [the injunctions] are summed up for the householder. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.48 //
Like the [injunction of] silence, for the others also, because of the teaching. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.49 //
Without making [it] manifest, because of the logical connection. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.50 //
Even the worldly [fruit accrues], when there is no obstruction from what is irrelevant, for so [scripture] shows. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.51 //
Thus there is no restriction regarding the fruit of liberation to [any particular] condition, because that condition is ascertained [to be irrelevant]. // <s>BBs</s> 3,4.52 //
Repetition [of meditation is necessary], because of the repeated instruction. // <s>BBs</s> 4,1.1 //
And because of the indicatory mark. // <s>BBs</s> 4,1.2 //
But [the scriptures] approach [<s>Brahman</s>] as the Self, and cause [it] to be grasped [as such]. // <s>BBs</s> 4,1.3 //

children.text: na pratīke na hi saḥ | BBs_4,1.4 |
children.translated_text: Not in a symbol (<s>pratīka</s>), for it is not that [<s>Brahman</s>]. // <s>BBs</s> 4,1.4 //
The view of <s>Brahman</s> [is to be superimposed on the symbol], because of the elevation. // <s>BBs</s> 4,1.5 //
And the views regarding <s>Āditya</s> (the sun) and the like [are to be superimposed] as subsidiaries, because it is reasonable. // <s>BBs</s> 4,1.6 //
Seated, because it is possible. // <s>BBs</s> 4,1.7 //
And because of <s>dhyāna</s> (meditation). // <s>BBs</s> 4,1.8 //
And with regard to immobility. // <s>BBs</s> 4,1.9 //
And [the <s>Smṛtis</s>] remember [thus]. // <s>BBs</s> 4,1.10 //
Wherever there is concentration, [one may meditate] there, because of the absence of distinction. // <s>BBs</s> 4,1.11 //

children.text: ā prayāṇāt tatrāpi hi dṛṣṭam | BBs_4,1.12 |
children.translated_text: Until death, for that too is seen [in scripture]. // <s>BBs</s> 4,1.12 //
Upon attaining that [knowledge], there is non-attachment of later [sins] and destruction of prior [sins], because of the scriptural declaration of that. // <s>BBs</s> 4,1.13 //

children.text: itarasyāpy evam asaṃśleṣaḥ pāte tu | BBs_4,1.14 |
children.translated_text: For the other [i.e., prior sins] also, similarly, there is non-attachment; but upon death. // <s>BBs</s> 4,1.14 //

children.text: anārabdhakārya eva tu pūrve tadavadheḥ | BBs_4,1.15 |
children.translated_text: But only those [prior sins] whose effects have not yet begun [to operate], because that is the limit. // <s>BBs</s> 4,1.15 //
But the <s>Agnihotra</s> and the rest [are to be performed] for the sake of that [knowledge] alone, for so [scripture] shows. // <s>BBs</s> 4,1.16 //
Also other [works are means to knowledge] according to some, in both [ways]. // <s>BBs</s> 4,1.17 //
For [scripture says], 'Whatever [is done] with knowledge [is more effective].' // <s>BBs</s> 4,1.18 //

children.text: bhogena tv itare kṣapayitvātha saṃpadyate | BBs_4,1.19 |
children.translated_text: But having exhausted the others through experience, one then attains [liberation]. // <s>BBs</s> 4,1.19 //
Speech [is merged] in the mind, because of the seeing [in scripture] and from the [scriptural] word. // <s>BBs</s> 4,2.1 //
And for this very reason, all [organs merge] successively. // <s>BBs</s> 4,2.2 //
That mind [merges] in the <s>prāṇa</s> (breath), because of the subsequent [scriptural passage]. // <s>BBs</s> 4,2.3 //
That [breath merges] in the ruler [i.e., the individual self], because of the approach to that and other [reasons]. // <s>BBs</s> 4,2.4 //
[The self merges] in the elements, because of the scriptural teaching of that. // <s>BBs</s> 4,2.5 //
Not in one [element alone], for [scripture] shows [otherwise]. // <s>BBs</s> 4,2.6 //
And [the procedure is] the same [for the knower and the non-knower] up to the beginning of the journey, and having nourished immortality. // <s>BBs</s> 4,2.7 //
Because of the attainment of that [self by the elements], and because of the designation of <s>saṃsāra</s> (transmigration). // <s>BBs</s> 4,2.8 //
[The body that departs is] subtle, from inference, and because it is so perceived. // <s>BBs</s> 4,2.9 //
Not by destruction, therefore. // <s>BBs</s> 4,2.10 //
And this warmth [belongs] to this [subtle body] alone, because of its reasonableness. // <s>BBs</s> 4,2.11 //

children.text: pratiṣedhād iti cen na śārīrāt | BBs_4,2.12 |
children.translated_text: If [one objects] because of the prohibition — no, [it refers] to the embodied [self]. // <s>BBs</s> 4,2.12 //
For in [the texts] of some, [the departure is] explicit. // <s>BBs</s> 4,2.13 //
And [thus] it is remembered [in the <s>Smṛti</s>]. // <s>BBs</s> 4,2.14 //

children.text: tāni pare tathā hy āha | BBs_4,2.15 |
children.translated_text: Those [elements go] to the Supreme, for so [scripture] says. // <s>BBs</s> 4,2.15 //
[They are] non-separate, because of the [scriptural] statement. // <s>BBs</s> 4,2.16 //

children.text: tadokograjvalanaṃ tatprakāśitadvāro vidyāsāmarthyāt taccheṣagatyanusmṛtiyogāc ca hārdānugṛhītāḥ śatādhikayā | BBs_4,2.17 |
children.translated_text: The blazing of the tip of the heart, the opening illuminated by that, [the self departs] through the power of <s>vidyā</s> (knowledge), and by the connection with the remembrance of the path belonging to that [<s>Brahman</s>]; favored by the One in the heart, through [the channel] of a hundred and one. // <s>BBs</s> 4,2.17 //
[The self departs] following the rays [of the sun]. // <s>BBs</s> 4,2.18 //

children.text: niśi neti cen na sambandhasya yāvaddehabhāvitvād darśayati ca | BBs_4,2.19 |
children.translated_text: If [one says] not at night — no, because the connection [with the rays] exists as long as the body lasts; and [scripture] shows [this]. // <s>BBs</s> 4,2.19 //
And therefore, even during the southern course [of the sun, departure to <s>Brahman</s> is possible]. // <s>BBs</s> 4,2.20 //

children.text: yoginaḥ prati ca smaryete smārte caite | BBs_4,2.21 |
children.translated_text: And for the <s>yogin</s> also, [these two paths] are remembered; and these are of the <s>Smṛti</s> [tradition]. // <s>BBs</s> 4,2.21 //
By the path beginning with light (<s>arcis</s>), because that [path] is well-known [in scripture]. // <s>BBs</s> 4,3.1 //
[The self goes] to the wind, from the year, because of both the non-specific and the specific [scriptural statements]. // <s>BBs</s> 4,3.2 //
Beyond the lightning, [there is] <s>Varuṇa</s>, because of the connection. // <s>BBs</s> 4,3.3 //
[Those on the path are] conductors (<s>ātivāhikas</s>), because of the indicatory mark of that. // <s>BBs</s> 4,3.4 //
Because of the removal of both [kinds of] confusion, that [conduction] is established. // <s>BBs</s> 4,3.5 //
From there, by the lightning-person alone, because of the scriptural teaching of that. // <s>BBs</s> 4,3.6 //
[The soul goes to] the effected [<s>Brahman</s>, i.e., <s>Hiraṇyagarbha</s>], [says] <s>Bādari</s>, because of the reasonableness of the journey for this one. // <s>BBs</s> 4,3.7 //
And because [that <s>Brahman</s>] is qualified [in the texts]. // <s>BBs</s> 4,3.8 //
But because of proximity, that designation [is given]. // <s>BBs</s> 4,3.9 //

children.text: kāryātyaye tadadhyakṣeṇa sahātaḥ param abhidhānāt | BBs_4,3.10 |
children.translated_text: At the dissolution of the effected [<s>Brahman</s>], together with that ruler, from that to the Supreme, because of the declaration. // <s>BBs</s> 4,3.10 //
And because of the <s>Smṛti</s>. // <s>BBs</s> 4,3.11 //
To the Supreme [<s>Brahman</s> directly], [says] <s>Jaimini</s>, because of being primary. // <s>BBs</s> 4,3.12 //
And because of [scriptural] showing. // <s>BBs</s> 4,3.13 //
And there is no intention of attainment toward the effected [<s>Brahman</s>]. // <s>BBs</s> 4,3.14 //

children.text: apratīkālambanān nayatīti bādarāyaṇa ubhayathā ca doṣāt tatkratuś ca | BBs_4,3.15 |
children.translated_text: [The person in the lightning] leads those who do not rely on a symbol (<s>pratīka</s>); thus [holds] <s>Bādarāyaṇa</s>, because of defect in both [other views]; and [on account of] the principle 'as one meditates, so one becomes' (<s>tatkratuḥ</s>). // <s>BBs</s> 4,3.15 //
And [scripture] shows a distinction. // <s>BBs</s> 4,3.16 //
Upon attainment, the manifestation is in one's own [true nature], because of the [scriptural] word. // <s>BBs</s> 4,4.1 //
[The self is] liberated, because of the promise [made in scripture]. // <s>BBs</s> 4,4.2 //
[It is] the Self, because of the context. // <s>BBs</s> 4,4.3 //
Because it is seen [to be] without distinction. // <s>BBs</s> 4,4.4 //
With the qualities of <s>Brahman</s>, [says] <s>Jaimini</s>, because of the mention and other [reasons]. // <s>BBs</s> 4,4.5 //
As pure consciousness alone, because of its being of that nature; thus [holds] <s>Auḍulomi</s>. // <s>BBs</s> 4,4.6 //

children.text: evam apy upanyāsāt pūrvabhāvād avirodhaṃ bādarāyaṇaḥ | BBs_4,4.7 |
children.translated_text: Even so, because of the mention and the prior state, there is no contradiction; [thus holds] <s>Bādarāyaṇa</s>. // <s>BBs</s> 4,4.7 //
But by mere will (<s>saṃkalpa</s>), because of the scriptural teaching of that. // <s>BBs</s> 4,4.8 //
And for this very reason, [the liberated self has] no other ruler. // <s>BBs</s> 4,4.9 //

children.text: abhāvaṃ bādarir āha hy evam | BBs_4,4.10 |
children.translated_text: Absence [of body], [says] <s>Bādari</s>, for [scripture] says thus. // <s>BBs</s> 4,4.10 //
Existence [of body], [says] <s>Jaimini</s>, because of the thinking [mentioned in the context] of the options. // <s>BBs</s> 4,4.11 //
Of both kinds, like the twelve-day [sacrifice], [says] <s>Bādarāyaṇa</s>, therefore. // <s>BBs</s> 4,4.12 //
In the absence of a body, [enjoyment is] as in a dream, because it is reasonable. // <s>BBs</s> 4,4.13 //
In the presence [of a body], as in the waking state. // <s>BBs</s> 4,4.14 //
The entry [into multiple bodies is] like a lamp; for so [scripture] shows. // <s>BBs</s> 4,4.15 //
With reference to either deep sleep or attainment [of <s>Brahman</s>], it is made manifest; for [so scripture says]. // <s>BBs</s> 4,4.16 //
Except the activity of [creating] the world, because of the context and because of the absence of proximity. // <s>BBs</s> 4,4.17 //
If [one objects] because of the direct teaching — no, because the statement [concerns] one situated in the sphere of qualification. // <s>BBs</s> 4,4.18 //

children.text: vikāravarti ca tathā hi sthitim āha | BBs_4,4.19 |
children.translated_text: And [that power of the liberated soul extends] over that which is subject to modification, for thus [scripture] states [its] abiding. || BBs_4,4.19 ||
And perception and inference show it to be so. || BBs_4,4.20 ||
And because of the indication of mere equality in enjoyment. || BBs_4,4.21 ||
Non-return, [as known] from scripture; non-return, [as known] from scripture. || BBs_4,4.22 ||
